slides.label: Walking backward
slides.title:
Second
drafts
slides.subtitle:
Why a graha walking backward in your chart
goes back for what was missed

slides.label: The story
slides.title: Looking back
body: changes path and goes to save them

slides.label: What it means
slides.title: Nothing reverses
body: From Earth, a graha seems to walk backward
when it’s at its closest to us
The classics give it full strength
slides.note: Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra, on strength

slides.label: In real life
slides.title: Three people
items:
Mercury walking backward: rewrites every email,
the best editor in the office

Venus walking backward: the second choice
in love and money is the one that lasts

Saturn walking backward: old duties come back
to be finished properly

slides.label: Sutra
slides.quote:
Some gifts arrive
as second drafts

slides.label: Practical remedy
slides.title: Build in a review
body: Find any graha walking backward in your chart
In that part of life, plan a second look
Sleep on the email; wait a week on the purchase
slides.closing:
Ask which of your grahas walk backward
at asksutram.com
